text: Agent said station 3 should run at 100A. Worker replied: That's usually true, but on Tuesdays after lunch station 3 overheats. We drop the current by 5%.
Worker said: Polyester from Hotel A shrinks when washed together with cotton. We always separate it and use a cooler cycle.
Worker said: Dryer 2 runs best at 80°C for towels.
Worker said: No, dryer 2 should be 72°C for towels or it damages the fabric.
Worker joked: Maybe we should just run everything at 200°C and go home early.
